audit_items.proof_trace: All public liquidation entry points call `pre_liquidation_check`, which invokes `app.ensure_has_permission(object::id(cap), whitelist_admin::liquidation())` — a two-step bitmask guard that first asserts cap membership in the whitelist VecMap, then verifies bit 2 is set in the 32-bit permission mask. `PackageCallerCap` can only be minted via `mint_cap` (public(package), unreachable externally) through `mint_new_whitelist` which requires `&AdminCap`, and newly minted caps start with permission 0; only `update_permission(_: &AdminCap, ...)` can grant the liquidation bit. The type-system gate plus admin-controlled permission model together make it impossible for an unauthorized caller to satisfy both conditions.
